Releasing
Session: ADB991-claude-20261122-a7c2

Not proved in this sweep of Ch10_TraceSpectral/Sec1.lean (PR to follow from branch claude/sweep-ch10-sec1-a7c2, which proves #4877 #4879 #4883 #4884 #4885 #4897 #4898 #4902). Note for the next person: in this file, unifying through the Schwartz–Bruhat subtypes or the weighted Lp subspaces is very slow (even `obtain ⟨_, _⟩ := (mem_adelePolarSubspace f.val).mp f.property` hit the heartbeat limit; `have hz := ...; hz.1` did not). Stating the core as a private lemma over abstract groups and spaces, as done for the proved statements, keeps the module at about 80 s.

Partial route, not finished: `adelePolarSubspace_fourier` is now proved, and the private `adelePolarSubspace_fourier_abstract` shows θ(f) = θ(FFf) + FFf(0) with FFf(0) = 0 for polar f, so F is an involution on Θ₀. If θ(f) = 0 then θ(Ff)(g) = |g|⁻¹ θ(f)(g⁻¹) = 0 by Riemann–Roch, so F preserves the kernel. What remains is continuity: the continuous Fourier map is the private `exists_adeleFourier_clm` in Ch02 Sec2b (needs `import all`), followed by its restriction to ℬ₀ and the quotient map.
